literalSafety.scope: Synthetic quote/backtick/newline/Unicode ref literal roundtrip; no network/process escape

safetyFindings: Public hook toolKind/code_mode_exec and toolInputKind/javascript are Host authoritative. Exact source wrapper computes them from the marked actual tool object, not model params. Generic same-name shell exec has no mark and is refused.

The program is a complete byte-for-byte fixed fixture. It is not a semantic classifier, arbitrary-JS allow rule, partial string filter or program rewrite. Source id/version are JSON literals; independent hostile literal roundtrip probes did not execute injected operations.
Outer code/command must match and awaitResults is forced true; restartSafe true, language/typecheck/unknown keys, arbitrary store/network programs and additional control calls are rejected.

Nested tool calls go through the unchanged native policy/tool path and original ordinary source executor. Exact source ref, one attempted read and one logical policy completion are retained with current request/v2 guard/cancellation/deadline checks.

Synchronous immutable counters snapshots are published inside the restriction, including denial before native short-circuit. Throwing/async sinks close the test; only the returned observer rejection is consumed. No global exception handler is installed.

collectionComplete is always false. Same-run independent official terminal/inactive/zero-pending facts are required for terminalObserved. Completed internal source execution is not model delivery/semantic proof.
limits: These are fixed-source synthetic collaborator replays. No actual Guest worker, Gateway/browser callbacks, source grant/body or provider was executed.

The normal hook validates params at its public pre-execution boundary; it is not a cryptographic seal against later trusted hooks changing final parameters. Actual final Host transformations and active loader behavior remain part of later reviewed execution wiring; changed/unknown final behavior must not be described as verified or silently allowed.
The new private loader callback must persist each snapshot synchronously, not reuse the old getter/registration-only callback. No private seed or concrete launch is accepted here.

The exact fixed program must be supplied in a newly approved request; arbitrary model formatting fails. This is a bounded transport/data-supply test, not autonomous semantic tool selection acceptance.
90second checks do not promise an unconditional provider kill or dollar cap. Prior paid authorization remains exhausted; executionReady staysfalse.
evidenceWhitelist: Exact frozen code-mode packet and minimal coordinator state/review-summary update; exclude unrelated PROJECT-STATE and all private seed/config/body/build data.
next: Preserve the six reviewed files plus exact non-sensitive packet. Then only mechanically review the new snapshot-loader wiring/final artifact/source hashes and any final parameter transformation boundary before deciding a separately authorized live request.
